title: Findify - Recommendations locked behind top Enterprise tier
clean_text: Personalized Recommendations, the core AI recommendation feature, is only available at Findify's top Enterprise tier starting at $1,199 per month, meaning merchants on the entry Essentials or mid-tier Professional plans cannot access product recommendations even with smart search and collections enabled. The Capterra listing shows zero accumulated user reviews as of early 2026, making third-party verification of real-world satisfaction limited compared to more established competitors.
